in_sanskrit.name: Anantha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anantha', which means 'without end, limitless, infinite, eternal'. It is often used to describe deities or concepts that are believed to be endless or eternal.

in_marathi.name: Ananthan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ananthan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ananthan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ananta', meaning infinite or endless. In Hindu mythology, Anantha is a serpent who supports the universe and is symbolic of infinite existence. The name Ananthan is thus bestowed upon children to signify their limitless potential and infinite growth.
